name: Index opening gap fill (fade the RTH open gap toward prior settlement)
author_year: MPM Markets research note (undated, approx. seven years of data); Trequattrini (2022, Nova SBE thesis, ES 1-minute data, 2000-2021); tradingstats.net NQ study (2015-2025)
instrument: NQ, ES, GC, SI, CL, HG (MPM six-market study); NQ and ES (tradingstats); ES (Trequattrini). No DAX study found in any source [uncertain]. Maven MT5 symbols for US100/US500 [uncertain].
timeframe: RTH open (09:30 ET) gap vs prior settlement or close; daily signal; 1-minute bars for ES in Trequattrini; horizons 0, 1, 3, 5, 10 sessions in MPM
entry_rule: Fade the gap toward the prior settlement. Variant from tradingstats: tiny gap plus first 15-minute candle moving toward fill. Trequattrini selects by gap size, zone and seasonality. No exact trade rule in MPM [uncertain].
exit_rule: Target: prior settlement/close (fill). Trailing stop after fill suggested in tradingstats but not specified [uncertain]. Same-session variant exits at session close [uncertain].
stop_rule: Not specified in any source read [uncertain].
holding_time: Intraday to same session for the same-day variant; up to 10 sessions for multi-session variants (MPM)
trades_per_year: [uncertain] Up to about 255 gap days per year (tradingstats: 2,791 NQ days 2015-2025); actual trade count depends on filter.
overnight_weekend: Same-session variant: no overnight. Multi-session variants (MPM up to 10 sessions) carry overnight risk.
signal_window_definition: tradingstats: RTH open minus prior RTH close, all gap sizes, normalised by 14-day ATR (tiny <0.3x, small 0.3-0.7x, medium 0.7-1.2x, large >1.2x). MPM: vs prior settlement, normalised by 10-day ATR. DST handling not discussed [uncertain].
sample_period: MPM: approx. seven years, dates unspecified. tradingstats: 2015-01-05 to 2025-12-30 NQ (2,791 days); its indicator section cites 2014-2024 for ES, which conflicts [uncertain]. Trequattrini: ES 2000-2021.
out_of_sample: None found. MPM: no OOS, only 'no parameter optimisation beyond the structural choice of the variant'. tradingstats: full-sample statistics, no walk-forward. Trequattrini: abstract claims an OOS validation method; results NOT verified [uncertain].
cost_assumption: MPM: costs described as 'realistic' with no figures. tradingstats: no costs or slippage stated. Trequattrini: not verified [uncertain].
reported_metrics: Fill rates only (tradingstats, NQ): 100% fill by close 60.3%; by size tiny 77.8%, small 42.0%, medium 25.6%, large 8.2%; selected tiny gap plus first 15-minute candle toward fill 93.1% (n=773, in-sample selected). MPM: no numeric fill rates; no profitable variant after costs. Fill rate is not a P&L measure.
third_party_replication: Partial. MPM and tradingstats are independent-looking but not peer-reviewed. A micro-futures backtest 2020-2025 (blog, unverified) found NQ barely and ES almost not profitable [uncertain].
evidence_grade: practitioner summary (MPM, tradingstats); thesis-level working paper for Trequattrini (not verified)
decay_status: [uncertain] No time split of fill rates in the sources read.
regime_split: Not found. Trequattrini notes gap-size and zone effects; no pre/post-2022 split [uncertain].
data_source_requirement: Daily RTH open and prior close plus 1-minute bars for entry timing. Available in Maven MT5 or Dukascopy for NQ/ES-type CFDs; DAX CFD gap data [uncertain].
min_lot_fit_5k10k: [uncertain] Not computable: no stop defined in any source, so per-trade risk % cannot be set. Gap sizes are normalised by ATR, which suggests a stop near ATR but this is not stated.
fn_rule_fit: The 09:30 ET open coincides with the US cash open and with 08:30 ET macro releases just before it; FN +-5 min news rule can be triggered [uncertain]. Same-session variant limits overnight exposure.
bot_policy_compliance: Rule-based and bot-compatible in principle; no messaging link needed. FN policy not verified [uncertain].
event_overlap: Overlaps the 09:30 ET cash open (highest-volatility minutes), 08:30 ET releases and the 10:00 ET release window. Opex and settlement not checked [uncertain].
overlap_with_existing: Not measured [uncertain]. Conceptually close to rejected ORB-style open logic and to NQ open logic in the live modules; no correlation computed.
rejected_catalog_hit: PARTIAL: fvg_doldurma (standalone_rejected). It is a fill rule on fair value gaps, not the opening gap, but its rejection reason (about 84% fill rate identical across pairs = base rate, no information) applies directly. No opening-gap fill entry in the catalog. Confirm with: python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol gap
base_rate_check: YES, applies. A 60% same-day fill rate on NQ and 84% FVG fill are base rates. The correct check is fill rate versus the unconditional rate at which price touches the prior close within the same window; not computed in any source [uncertain].
pitfall_risk: High. Base-rate trap (fill rate is not profit; MPM finds no profitable variant after costs). Post-hoc setup selection (93.1% tiny-gap setup is in-sample). No OOS test in MPM or tradingstats. Small-sample subsets (n=30 for one setup).
